description: This file defines the StatusService class, which manages and updates status messages within the application, extending an abstract service and implementing a status service interface.

classes.name: StatusService
classes.description: A service class that handles dynamic status messages and notifies observers of message changes, extending AbstractService.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a new message directly, overriding dynamic messages, and triggers message recomputation.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the dynamic message list and recomputes the overall message.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the dynamic messages list and updates the composite message.

methods.name: recomputeMessage
methods.description: Recalculates the combined message string from dynamic and directly set messages, then notifies observers.

methods.name: messageFromArray
methods.description: Concatenates an array of messages into a single comma-separated string.

ctags.name: StatusService
ctags.pattern: /^export class StatusService extends AbstractService<StatusServiceEvent, string> implements Status/
